name: aasist-tk
trained_on: ASVspoof 2019 LA train + Turkmen set (Common Voice and broadcast speech; 9 seen generators), fine-tuned from the official AASIST weights (clovaai/aasist, MIT)

extra.calibrated_on: Turkmen dev + ASVspoof 2019 LA dev subset
extra.evaluated_on: Turkmen test (incl. 2 unseen generators) and ASVspoof 2019 LA eval
extra.note: Provisional: 6 epochs only (Kaggle time budget); Turkmen dev error was still falling. Turkmen test: AUC 0.759, EER 31.1 % (seen generators 26.2 %, held-out 37.9 %).
extra.max_verdict_reason: Real Turkmen speech is still judged fake in 8.3 % of test clips (22.6 % when quiet) and only 44.4 % is judged real; the limit stays until a longer training run lowers this.
